My name is Juan Gatica. I am currently a grad student at the Zicklin School of Business, majoring in Quantitative Methods & Modeling. I come from a public health background, having graduated from the NYU College of Global Public Health with a Master's of Public Health Degree in Epidemiology. I have a passion for research in the field of addiction, particularly opioids, and for understanding the determinants of health that accompany addiction.
